03 / INDUSTRIAL HEATING FUEL · REV 0.1 | 02 NOV 2026

Indian standard reference, with tighter Rerol working targets for batch release.

DOCUMENT RRL-QC-LDO-003

A. Applicable product standard: IS 15770:2021

SEASONAL RULE Winter for the standard means November through February; summer is the remainder of the year.

SULPHUR *Standard table shows 0.005-1.50% by mass. Lower sulphur levels or other emission-related limits may apply by purchaser, permit and location. Rerol ≤1.00% is a proposed tighter target, not a measured value.

USE / CLAIM For authorised industrial heating applications, not automotive diesel. An LDO label or claim of conformity should follow complete batch testing to IS 15770 and confirmation that production, storage and sale are authorised.

REFERENCE BASIS IndianOil-hosted IS 15770:2021 Table 1; BIS product manual PM/15770/01 (Dec 2024).
